_meta.description: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003 — Rules applicable to Industrial Buildings (Factories, Warehouses, Workshops)

rules.title: Minimum Plot Area for Industrial Use
rules.error_message: Plot area {actual} sqm is below the minimum {expected} sqm required for industrial buildings.
rules.recommendation: Industrial developments require at least 300 sqm plot area for operational safety.
rules.explanation: Industrial activities need larger plots to provide adequate setbacks, loading bays, and safety buffers.

rules.title: Minimum Road Width for Industrial Access
rules.error_message: Abutting road width {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m required for heavy industrial vehicle movement.
rules.recommendation: Industrial developments require a minimum road width of 15.0 m to accommodate trucks and heavy machinery.
rules.explanation: Heavy vehicular movement and freight transport require wide access roads.
